question: How has fire activity changed over time?
metric: Large-fire occurrence and mapped burned-area footprint
historical_value: 2 FPA fires >=1000 acres; 1 MTBS fire intersecting El Rito; 3.71% unique watershed area burned
recent_value: 8 FPA fires >=1000 acres; 3 MTBS fires intersecting El Rito; 6.06% unique watershed area burned
change: FPA >=1000-acre fires increased 300%; unique mapped watershed area burned increased 2.35 percentage points
interpretation: Large-fire activity increased during 2015-2024, and a larger unique share of the El Rito watershed was affected by mapped fire.
evidence: FPA fires >=1000 acres increased from 2 to 8. MTBS mapped fires intersecting El Rito increased from 1 to 3. Unique mapped burned area increased from 3.71% to 6.06% of the watershed.
caveat: FPA occurrence records may be influenced by reporting practices. MTBS represents mapped significant fires and is not a complete inventory of all fires.
